name: Refactor: extract duplicated validation
prompt: The three services (src/services/user-service.ts, project-service.ts, ticket-service.ts) each contain identical copies of the helpers `requireString(value, field)` and `checkLength(value, field, min, max)`. Extract them into a single shared module `src/util/validation.ts` that exports both functions with the same signatures and error messages, and make the three services import from it. Behaviour must not change; all existing tests must keep passing.
